title: 第一卷 第9章 姑娘得罪了第一卷 第10章 15万
slug: 徒儿下山祸害你七个师姐去吧
content_zh:
;;
夏双竹眼见叶青云不说话了，越发觉得后者是心虚。
她冷哼一声。
“哼！满嘴胡诌的家伙！”
胡中一看了一眼叶青云，便不再理会。
专心于将小女孩身上的银针拔出。
很快，小女孩身上的七根银针被胡中一一一拔出。
叶青云嘴中默念。
“5。”
“4。”
“3。”
“2。”
“1。”
伴随着“1”的落下，原本脸色红润的小女孩突然全身一抖。
紧接着，她双手抱住自己，声音颤抖。
“好冷啊！妈妈，团团好冷！”
周艳芳脸色狂变，她赶紧把小女孩抱住。
“团团别怕，妈妈在这。”
这时，周艳芳发现她的女儿脸色异常苍白，呈现一种病态白。
周艳芳立马就急了，急忙对胡中一开口道。

“胡大师，我女儿这是什么情况？
她怎么又全身发冷了？”
其实不用周艳芳说，胡中一已经察觉到小女孩的异样了。
胡中一紧锁眉头，心中暗道。
这不对啊！
按理说，这位小女孩被施展了鬼门针法，她应该康复了啊！
怎么可能还会复发了？
周围不少人窃窃私语。
“咦，这小女孩还真和那位年轻人说的一样，五秒钟后，病情就复发了。”
“难道这位年轻人说的都是真的？”
这些话落在胡中一的耳中。
胡中一的目光看向叶青云，觉得很是荒谬。
面前这位年轻人如此年轻，能懂什么中医之术？
多半是他胡乱说，正好瞎猫碰上死耗子罢了！
但，周艳芳呆不住了。
她眼见胡大师一副无能为力的模样。
而，面前这位年轻人能够精准料到她女儿的病会复发。
绝对是有点东西的！
现在女儿全身冰凉，周艳芳担心女儿再不被医治，怕是会死在这。
于是，她对叶青云哀求道。

“小伙子，刚才是我不对。
我在这给你道歉。我相信你是一位医术高明的医生。
我的女儿是无辜的，还希望你出手救她一命！”

Seeing that Ye Qingyun stopped talking, Xia Shuangzhu felt more and more that the latter had a guilty conscience.
She snorted coldly.
"Hmph! You're a guy who talks nonsense!"
Hu Zhong glanced at Ye Qingyun and ignored him.
Concentrate on pulling out the silver needle from the little girl's body.
Soon, Hu Zhong pulled out the seven silver needles on the little girl one by one.
Ye Qingyun muttered silently.
"5."
"4."
"3."
"2."
"1."
As "1" fell, the little girl with a rosy face suddenly trembled all over.
Then she hugged herself with her hands, her voice trembling.
"It's so cold! Mom, it's so cold!"
Zhou Yanfang's face changed wildly, and she quickly hugged the little girl.
"Don't be afraid, Tuantuan, mom is here."
At this time, Zhou Yanfang discovered that her daughter's face was abnormally pale, showing a sickly white color.
Zhou Yanfang immediately became anxious and hurriedly spoke to Hu Zhongyi.
"Master Hu, what's going on with my daughter?
Why is she feeling cold all over again? "
In fact, Zhou Yanfang didn't need to say that Hu Zhongyi had already noticed something strange about the little girl.
Hu Zhongyi frowned and thought to himself.
This is wrong!
It stands to reason that this little girl should have recovered after being subjected to the Guimen Acupuncture Technique!
How could it happen again?
Many people around were whispering.
"Hey, this little girl is exactly what the young man said. Five seconds later, her condition relapsed."
"Is everything this young man said true?"
These words fell on Hu Zhongyi's ears.
Hu Zhongyi looked at Ye Qingyun and thought it was ridiculous.
The young man in front of me is so young. What kind of traditional Chinese medicine does he know?
He was probably just talking nonsense, just like a blind cat meets a dead mouse!
However, Zhou Yanfang couldn't stay any longer.
She saw Master Hu looking helpless.
However, the young man in front of him could accurately predict that her daughter's disease would relapse.
There is definitely something!
Now her daughter's body is cold, and Zhou Yanfang is worried that her daughter will die here if she is not treated.
So, she begged Ye Qingyun.
"Young man, it was my fault just now.
I'm here to apologize to you. I believe you are a skilled doctor.
My daughter is innocent, and I hope you will save her life! "
